name: Shivani S
bio: I'm Shivani, a Computer Science and Engineering undergraduate at TKM College of Engineering, Kerala, interested in building meaningful software, exploring AI and machine learning, and contributing to developer communities.

My journey includes software development projects, NLP research, open-source contributions, hackathons, and student leadership. I enjoy working with people, organising initiatives, documenting ideas, and turning concepts into practical solutions.
I'm currently exploring opportunities in Software Engineering, Web Development, and AI/ML while continuing to grow as a developer and researcher.
